prompt: RimWorld creature sprite, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background. The hair is patched with grey-green moss and lilac lichen growing on it like ground cover. Side view, seen from the side: the dome in profile, hair hem on the ground, the front lip at one end and the rear curtain at the other. Rear view, seen from behind: an unbroken curtain of pale hair with a single central parted hank, the haunches rounded and the hind feet at the hem. Silhouette edges are clean: hair tips fade to transparent in pale grey-white with no coloured fringe pixels.
